coverageContext: Complete 29-term nonsyndromic cleft lip with or without cleft palate research model. BioVU evaluation included only 46 cases and 72,496 controls of non-Hispanic European ancestry (AUROC 0.66), so the large total sample does not imply many affected participants. The separate PDGFRA family experiments are not part of this additive score. This is not a syndromic-variant test, prenatal screen, carrier assessment, future-child risk calculation, or reproductive recommendation.

Complete UK Biobank penalized-regression research model for coded corneal dystrophy. Six ancestry-group evaluations reported adjusted partial correlations, not diagnostic probabilities; European correlations were modest (about 0.038 to 0.075), and non-European intervals included zero. The EUR reference cannot establish applicability to an individual. This is not a corneal examination, dystrophy-subtype or monogenic-variant test, prognosis of vision loss, or treatment recommendation.
